name: Owen Mermaid

releases.author: towishy
releases.description:
## What changed

- Opens the exact clicked Mermaid source block and rejects ambiguous stale matches.
- Enables direct background-drag panning for oversized editor canvases.
- Wraps, scales, and truncates long node labels inside their shapes.
- Improves Apply button contrast across light and dark themes.
- Aligns inline controls with the rendered SVG and strengthens Obsidian smoke coverage.

## Validation

- 37 automated tests passed.
- Production TypeScript build passed.
- Obsidian UI smoke test passed for toolbar alignment, editor panning, and Live Preview.
releases.name: Owen Mermaid 0.2.17

releases.author: towishy
releases.description: Refined the visual Mermaid editor with a roomier inspector, ribbon zoom controls, drag-to-pan canvas navigation, and a wider work area without the minimap. Added reliable hover actions for dynamically rendered Mermaid diagrams in Live Preview, improved settings layout and bilingual labels, and expanded the real Obsidian smoke test to cover Reading View, editor interactions, and Live Preview. Validation: 30 tests passed, production build passed, release check passed, and the Obsidian UI smoke test passed.
